answer: In 2025, the Denver Hub recorded measurable snowfall on 7.14% of valid days (representing 26 of 364 valid days). When including trace snowfall, the percentage rises to 12.36%, covering 45 days. The difference reflects days with trace amounts that are excluded from measurable totals. There was 1 missing day on 2025-05-21 out of 365 expected days, with coverage at 99.73%.

weather_stats.definition: days with measurable new snowfall (reported > 0; trace excluded)

sources.attribution: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information, GHCN-Daily

assumptions: Observations from NOAA station USW00003017 represent the Denver Hub.
Percentages use days with a valid observation as the denominator; missing and quality-flagged days are excluded, never counted as zero.
Denver International Airport is ~30 km northeast of downtown on the plains; airport snowfall typically differs from city-centre snowfall.
Measurable snowfall = reported amount > 0; trace (NOAA flag 'T') is counted only in the trace-inclusive definition.
limitations: Hubs are illustrative examples, not actual company facilities.
Exposure at the county (FEMA) or airport-station (NOAA) level is not site-specific.
